_note: Base Systems: bakes run on them (a bake's "os") and boot images start from them (an image's "base"). "image": a hand-made image in images/ (until the os bakes replace them, P5); "snapshot": an os bake's snapshot in baked/; "built": an image build.py makes (images/<name>.img: a System plus the tools layer). 7.5.5 and 7.6.1 boot on both machines.
